claim: *Recovery-ordering model.* The decisive fact is the absent transition from FALLBACK_STAGED directly to DB_UPDATED.

topology.description: Legal recovery sequence; staged artifact cannot skip upload before database update.

required_terms: Durable state may not name an artifact recovery has not yet published.
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. State gray and explicit forbidden cross restored; legal upload-before-database order retained.

alt: FALLBACK_STAGED leads to FALLBACK_UPLOADED on upload success, then to DB_UPDATED when durable state is updated. A crossed dashed direct edge from staged to database updated is forbidden: durable state must not name an artifact before recovery publishes it. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
